async function renderOpenHouseAdminStaff(){
  const body=document.getElementById('oh-admin-staff-body'), empty=document.getElementById('oh-admin-staff-empty');
  if(!body) return;
  const status=document.getElementById('oh-admin-staff-status')?.value||'ALL';
  const q=(document.getElementById('oh-admin-staff-search')?.value||'').toLowerCase().trim();
  let list=await getOpenHouseStaff();
  list=list.filter(s=>(status==='ALL'||s.status===status)&&(!q||`${s.name} ${s.uni}`.toLowerCase().includes(q)));
  body.innerHTML='';
  if(!list.length){empty.style.display='block';return;} empty.style.display='none';
  list.forEach(s=>{
    const badge=s.status==='approved'?'oh-status-approved':s.status==='interview'?'oh-status-interview':s.status==='rejected'?'oh-status-rejected':'oh-status-pending';
    const txt=s.status==='approved'?'ผ่านคัดเลือก':s.status==='interview'?'นัดสัมภาษณ์':s.status==='rejected'?'ไม่ผ่าน':'รอพิจารณา';
    const tr=document.createElement('tr');
    tr.innerHTML=`<td><strong>${ohSafe(s.name)}</strong></td>
      <td>${ohSafe(s.uni)}<br><small>${ohSafe(s.year)}</small></td>
      <td>${ohSafe(s.dept)}</td>
      <td>${ohSafe(s.phone)}<br><small>${ohSafe(s.line||'-')}</small></td>
      <td>${ohSafe((s.shirt||'-').split(' ')[0])}</td>
      <td><span class="badge ${badge}">${txt}</span></td>
      <td><div style="display:flex;gap:4px;flex-wrap:wrap">
        <button class="btn btn-sm btn-ghost" onclick="updateOpenHouseStaffStatus('${s.id}','approved')">✓ ผ่าน</button>
        <button class="btn btn-sm btn-ghost" onclick="updateOpenHouseStaffStatus('${s.id}','interview')">สัมภาษณ์</button>
        <button class="btn btn-sm btn-danger" onclick="updateOpenHouseStaffStatus('${s.id}','rejected')">✕</button>
      </div></td>`;
    body.appendChild(tr);
  });
}
async function updateOpenHouseStaffStatus(id,status){
  const s=await storeGet(OH_STAFF_PREFIX+id); if(!s)return;
  s.status=status; s.updatedAt=new Date().toISOString();
  await storeSet(OH_STAFF_PREFIX+id,s);
  toast('อัปเดตสถานะ Staff เรียบร้อย','success');
  await renderOpenHouseAdmin();
  if(document.getElementById('view-election')?.classList.contains('active')) await renderElection();
}
async function renderOpenHouseAdminAttendees(){
  const body=document.getElementById('oh-admin-attendee-body'), empty=document.getElementById('oh-admin-attendee-empty');
  if(!body) return;
  const role=document.getElementById('oh-admin-attendee-role')?.value||'ALL';
  const slot=document.getElementById('oh-admin-attendee-slot')?.value||'ALL';
  const q=(document.getElementById('oh-admin-attendee-search')?.value||'').toLowerCase().trim();
  let list=await getOpenHouseAttendees();
  list=list.filter(a=>(role==='ALL'||a.role===role)&&(slot==='ALL'||(a.slot||'').includes(slot))&&(!q||`${a.name} ${a.school}`.toLowerCase().includes(q)));
  body.innerHTML='';
  if(!list.length){empty.style.display='block';return;} empty.style.display='none';
  list.forEach(a=>{
    const tr=document.createElement('tr');
    tr.innerHTML=`<td><code>${ohSafe(a.code)}</code></td>
      <td><strong>${ohSafe(a.name)}</strong><br><small>${ohSafe(a.phone)}</small></td>
      <td>${ohSafe(a.role)}</td><td>${ohSafe(a.school)}</td>
      <td>${ohSafe((a.slot||'').split(':')[0])}</td>
      <td style="max-width:200px">${ohSafe((a.workshops||[]).join(', ')||'-')}</td>
      <td><button class="btn btn-sm ${a.checkedIn?'btn-primary':'btn-ghost'} oh-attendee-check" onclick="toggleOpenHouseCheckIn('${a.id}')">${a.checkedIn?'✓ เช็คอินแล้ว':'เช็คอิน'}</button></td>`;
    body.appendChild(tr);
  });
}
async function toggleOpenHouseCheckIn(id){
  const a=await storeGet(OH_ATT_PREFIX+id); if(!a)return;
  a.checkedIn=!a.checkedIn; a.checkedInAt=a.checkedIn?new Date().toISOString():null;
  await storeSet(OH_ATT_PREFIX+id,a);
  toast(a.checkedIn?'เช็คอินเรียบร้อย':'ยกเลิกการเช็คอิน','success');
  await renderOpenHouseAdmin();
}

const ELECTION_KEY = 'election:president:config';
const ELECTION_CAND_PREFIX = 'election:candidate:';
const ELECTION_VOTE_PREFIX = 'election:vote:';
// The original source contains 13 university options; the election is configured for 12 as requested.
// If the federation's official 12-institution list differs, edit this array.
const ELECTION_UNIVERSITIES = [
  'มหาวิทยาลัยมหิดล','มหาวิทยาลัยเชียงใหม่','มหาวิทยาลัยขอนแก่น','มหาวิทยาลัยนเรศวร',
  'มหาวิทยาลัยนวมินทราธิราช','ราชวิทยาลัยจุฬาภรณ์','จุฬาลงกรณ์มหาวิทยาลัย',
  'มหาวิทยาลัยเทคโนโลยีสุรนารี','มหาวิทยาลัยรังสิต','มหาวิทยาลัยธรรมศาสตร์',
  'มหาวิทยาลัยวลัยลักษณ์','มหาวิทยาลัยสงขลานครินทร์'
];

async function getElectionConfig(){
  return (await storeGet(ELECTION_KEY)) || {open:true,title:'เลือกตั้งประธานสมาพันธ์ RTUT'};
}
async function getElectionCandidates(){
  const keys = await storeList(ELECTION_CAND_PREFIX);
  return (await Promise.all(keys.map(k=>storeGet(k)))).filter(Boolean);
}
async function getElectionVotes(){
  const keys = await storeList(ELECTION_VOTE_PREFIX);
  return (await Promise.all(keys.map(k=>storeGet(k)))).filter(Boolean);
}
function renderElectionUniversities(){
  const wrap=document.getElementById('election-university-list');
  const sel=document.getElementById('election-candidate-uni');
  if(wrap) wrap.innerHTML=ELECTION_UNIVERSITIES.map(u=>'<span class="pill">'+escapeHtml(u)+'</span>').join('');
  if(sel) sel.innerHTML='<option value="">— เลือกมหาวิทยาลัย —</option>'+ELECTION_UNIVERSITIES.map(u=>'<option>'+escapeHtml(u)+'</option>').join('');
}
async function findEligibleStaff(phone){
  if(!phone) return null;
  const member=await storeGet('member:'+phone);
  if(!member || !ELECTION_UNIVERSITIES.includes(member.university)) return null;

  const projectKeys=await storeList('application:'+phone+':');
  const projectApps=(await Promise.all(projectKeys.map(k=>storeGet(k)))).filter(Boolean);
  const approvedProject=projectApps.find(a=>a.status==='approved');
  if(approvedProject) return {member,staffApplication:approvedProject,source:'project'};

  const ohKeys=await storeList(OH_STAFF_PREFIX);
  const ohStaff=(await Promise.all(ohKeys.map(k=>storeGet(k)))).filter(Boolean);
  const approvedOH=ohStaff.find(a=>a.phone===phone && a.status==='approved' && ELECTION_UNIVERSITIES.includes(a.uni));
  if(approvedOH) return {member,staffApplication:approvedOH,source:'openhouse'};

  return null;
}
async function renderElection(){
  renderElectionUniversities();
  const cfg=await getElectionConfig();
  const candidates=await getElectionCandidates();
  const votes=await getElectionVotes();
  const badge=document.getElementById('election-status-badge');
  const cc=document.getElementById('election-candidate-count');
  const vc=document.getElementById('election-vote-count');
  if(badge){ badge.textContent=cfg.open?'● เปิดให้ลงคะแนน':'● ปิดการลงคะแนน'; badge.classList.toggle('closed',!cfg.open); }
  if(cc) cc.textContent=candidates.length;
  if(vc) vc.textContent=votes.length;
  const list=document.getElementById('election-candidate-list');
  const empty=document.getElementById('election-empty');
  if(!candidates.length){list.innerHTML='';empty.style.display='block';}else{
    empty.style.display='none';
    const eligible=currentMemberId ? await findEligibleStaff(currentMemberId) : null;
    const myVote=currentMemberId ? await storeGet(ELECTION_VOTE_PREFIX+currentMemberId) : null;
    const notice=document.getElementById('election-eligibility');
    if(notice){
      notice.style.display='block';
      if(myVote) notice.textContent='คุณใช้สิทธิ์เลือกตั้งแล้ว 1 สิทธิ์ ไม่สามารถลงคะแนนซ้ำได้';
      else if(eligible) notice.textContent='คุณมีสิทธิ์ลงคะแนนในฐานะ Staff ที่ได้รับการอนุมัติแล้ว';
      else notice.textContent='สิทธิ์เลือกตั้งจำกัดเฉพาะสมาชิกที่มีใบสมัคร Staff สถานะอนุมัติ และมหาวิทยาลัยอยู่ใน 12 สถาบันที่กำหนด';
    }
    list.innerHTML=candidates.map(c=>{
      const avatar=c.photo?'<img src="'+escapeAttr(c.photo)+'" alt="">':escapeHtml((c.name||'?').charAt(0));
      const disabled=!cfg.open || !eligible || !!myVote;
      return '<div class="election-candidate"><div class="candidate-avatar">'+avatar+'</div><div><div class="candidate-name">'+escapeHtml(c.name)+'</div><div class="candidate-meta">'+escapeHtml(c.university||'-')+'</div><div class="proj-desc">'+escapeHtml(c.platform||'')+'</div></div><div class="vote-action"><button class="btn btn-primary" '+(disabled?'disabled':'')+' onclick="castElectionVote(\''+escapeAttr(c.id)+'\')">'+(myVote?'ใช้สิทธิ์แล้ว':'ลงคะแนนให้ผู้สมัครนี้')+'</button></div></div>';
    }).join('');
  }
}
async function castElectionVote(candidateId){
  if(!currentMemberId){toast('กรุณาเข้าสู่ระบบสมาชิกก่อนลงคะแนน',true);goTo('profile');return;}
  const cfg=await getElectionConfig();
  if(!cfg.open){toast('ขณะนี้ปิดการลงคะแนนแล้ว',true);return;}
  const eligible=await findEligibleStaff(currentMemberId);
  if(!eligible){toast('บัญชีนี้ยังไม่มีสิทธิ์ลงคะแนน',true);return;}
  const existing=await storeGet(ELECTION_VOTE_PREFIX+currentMemberId);
  if(existing){toast('คุณใช้สิทธิ์ไปแล้ว 1 ครั้ง',true);return;}
  const candidate=await storeGet(ELECTION_CAND_PREFIX+candidateId);
  if(!candidate){toast('ไม่พบผู้สมัคร',true);return;}
  const ok=confirm('ยืนยันการลงคะแนนให้ '+candidate.name+' ?\nเมื่อยืนยันแล้วจะไม่สามารถเปลี่ยนคะแนนได้');
  if(!ok)return;
  const vote={id:'vote_'+Date.now(),voterPhone:currentMemberId,candidateId,university:eligible.member.university,createdAt:new Date().toISOString()};
  const result=await storeSet(ELECTION_VOTE_PREFIX+currentMemberId,vote);
  if(!result){toast('บันทึกคะแนนไม่สำเร็จ กรุณาลองใหม่',true);return;}
  toast('ลงคะแนนเรียบร้อย — 1 คนต่อ 1 สิทธิ์','success');
  await renderElection();
}
async function adminAddElectionCandidate(){
  if(!adminLoggedIn)return;
  const name=document.getElementById('election-candidate-name').value.trim();
  const university=document.getElementById('election-candidate-uni').value;
  const platform=document.getElementById('election-candidate-platform').value.trim();
  const photo=document.getElementById('election-candidate-photo').value.trim();
  if(!name||!university){toast('กรุณากรอกชื่อและมหาวิทยาลัยผู้สมัคร',true);return;}
  const id='cand_'+Date.now();
  await storeSet(ELECTION_CAND_PREFIX+id,{id,name,university,platform,photo,createdAt:new Date().toISOString()});
  document.getElementById('election-candidate-name').value='';
  document.getElementById('election-candidate-platform').value='';
  document.getElementById('election-candidate-photo').value='';
  toast('เพิ่มผู้สมัครแล้ว','success');
  renderElectionAdmin();
}
async function adminToggleElection(){
  if(!adminLoggedIn)return;
  const cfg=await getElectionConfig();
  cfg.open=!cfg.open;
  await storeSet(ELECTION_KEY,cfg);
  toast(cfg.open?'เปิดการลงคะแนนแล้ว':'ปิดการลงคะแนนแล้ว','success');
  renderElectionAdmin();
  renderElection();
}
async function renderElectionAdmin(){
  if(!adminLoggedIn)return;
  renderElectionUniversities();
  const cfg=await getElectionConfig();
  const candidates=await getElectionCandidates();
  const votes=await getElectionVotes();
  const status=document.getElementById('admin-election-status-text');
  if(status) status.textContent=(cfg.open?'เปิดรับคะแนนอยู่':'ปิดรับคะแนนแล้ว')+' • ใช้สิทธิ์แล้ว '+votes.length+' คน • ผู้สมัคร '+candidates.length+' คน';
  const toggle=document.getElementById('admin-election-toggle');
  if(toggle) toggle.textContent=cfg.open?'ปิดการลงคะแนน':'เปิดการลงคะแนน';
  const result=document.getElementById('admin-election-results');
  const rows=candidates.map(c=>({c,count:votes.filter(v=>v.candidateId===c.id).length})).sort((a,b)=>b.count-a.count);
  result.innerHTML='<h3 style="margin:0 0 10px;color:var(--navy);">ผลคะแนนสำหรับ Admin</h3>'+(rows.length?rows.map((r,i)=>'<div style="display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px;padding:10px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);"><span>'+escapeHtml(r.c.name)+'</span><strong>'+r.count+' คะแนน</strong></div>').join(''):'<div class="empty">ยังไม่มีผู้สมัคร</div>');
}

/* ---------------- member lookup / register ---------------- */
function selectedDeptGlobal(){ return document.querySelectorAll('.pill.sel'); }

async function lookupMember(source){
  const usingHome = source === 'home';
  const idFromHome = document.getElementById('lookup-id');
  const idFromGate = document.getElementById('gate-id');
  const passFromHome = document.getElementById('lookup-pass');
  const passFromGate = document.getElementById('gate-pass');
  const phone = (usingHome ? idFromHome.value : idFromGate.value).trim();
  const password = (usingHome ? passFromHome.value : passFromGate.value);

  if(!phone){ toast('กรุณากรอกเบอร์โทรศัพท์', true); return; }
  if(!password){ toast('กรุณากรอกรหัสผ่าน', true); return; }

  goTo('profile');
  document.getElementById('gate-id').value = phone;
  document.getElementById('gate-pass').value = password;

  const member = await storeGet('member:' + phone);
  if(!member){
    toast('ไม่พบข้อมูล — เริ่มลงทะเบียนใหม่ได้เลย');
    startRegister(phone);
    return;
  }
  if(member.password !== password){
    toast('เบอร์โทรศัพท์หรือรหัสผ่านไม่ถูกต้อง', true);
    return;
  }
  loadMemberIntoForm(member);
  toast('เข้าสู่ระบบสำเร็จ', 'success');
}

function startRegister(prefillPhone){
  currentMemberId = null;
  currentPhotoData = null;
  document.getElementById('profile-form').reset();
  document.getElementById('profile-form-title').textContent = 'ลงทะเบียนสมาชิกใหม่';
  document.getElementById('f-phone').value = prefillPhone || document.getElementById('gate-id').value.trim() || '';
  document.getElementById('f-password').value = document.getElementById('gate-pass').value || '';
  document.getElementById('id-name-preview').textContent = 'สมาชิกใหม่';
  document.getElementById('id-meta-preview').textContent = 'กรอกข้อมูลด้านล่างแล้วกดบันทึก';
  document.getElementById('id-avatar').innerHTML = '+';
  document.getElementById('photo-preview').innerHTML = '?';
  document.getElementById('btn-remove-photo').style.display = 'none';
  document.getElementById('id-badge').innerHTML = '';
  document.getElementById('btn-delete-account').style.display = 'none';
  document.getElementById('profile-form-wrap').style.display = 'block';
  document.getElementById('my-applications-wrap').style.display = 'none';
  initFormFieldReveal(document.getElementById('profile-form-wrap'));
}

  document.getElementById('f-university').value = member.university || '';
  document.getElementById('f-firstname').value = member.firstname || '';
  document.getElementById('f-lastname').value = member.lastname || '';
  document.getElementById('f-phone').value = member.phone || '';
  document.getElementById('f-password').value = member.password || '';
  document.getElementById('f-email').value = member.email || '';
  document.getElementById('f-line').value = member.line || '';
  document.getElementById('f-instagram').value = member.instagram || '';
  document.getElementById('f-emergency-phone').value = member.emergencyPhone || '';
  document.getElementById('f-emergency-relation').value = member.emergencyRelation || '';
  document.getElementById('f-medical-condition').value = member.medicalCondition || '';
  document.getElementById('f-regular-medication').value = member.regularMedication || '';
  document.getElementById('f-drug-allergy').value = member.drugAllergy || '';
  document.getElementById('f-food-restriction').value = member.foodRestriction || '';
  document.getElementById('f-pdpa-consent').checked = !!member.pdpaConsent;
  document.getElementById('f-year').value = member.year || 'ปี 1';
  document.getElementById('f-dept').value = member.dept || '';
  document.getElementById('f-position').value = member.position || '';
  document.getElementById('f-bio').value = member.bio || '';

  document.getElementById('id-name-preview').textContent = (member.firstname||'') + ' ' + (member.lastname||'');
  document.getElementById('id-meta-preview').textContent = (member.university||'ไม่ระบุมหาวิทยาลัย') + ' • ' + (member.year||'');
  const initial = (member.firstname||'?').charAt(0);
  if(member.photo){
    document.getElementById('id-avatar').innerHTML = '<img src="'+member.photo+'" alt="">';
    document.getElementById('photo-preview').innerHTML = '<img src="'+member.photo+'" alt="">';
    document.getElementById('btn-remove-photo').style.display = 'inline-flex';
  }else{
    document.getElementById('id-avatar').textContent = initial;
    document.getElementById('photo-preview').textContent = initial;
    document.getElementById('btn-remove-photo').style.display = 'none';
  }
  const status = member.year === 'บัณฑิตแล้ว (Alumnus)' ? 'alumnus' : 'active';
  document.getElementById('id-badge').innerHTML =
    '<span class="badge ' + status + '">' + (status==='alumnus' ? 'ศิษย์เก่า' : 'สมาชิก Active') + '</span>';

  document.getElementById('btn-delete-account').style.display = 'inline-flex';
  document.getElementById('profile-form-wrap').style.display = 'block';
  initFormFieldReveal(document.getElementById('profile-form-wrap'));
  updateAuthUI(member);
  renderMyApplications(member.phone);
}

async function saveProfile(e){
  e.preventDefault();
  const phone = document.getElementById('f-phone').value.trim();
  const password = document.getElementById('f-password').value;
  if(!phone){ toast('กรุณากรอกเบอร์โทรศัพท์', true); return; }
  if(!password){ toast('กรุณาตั้งรหัสผ่าน', true); return; }
  if(!document.getElementById('f-line').value.trim() || !document.getElementById('f-emergency-phone').value.trim() || !document.getElementById('f-emergency-relation').value.trim()){ toast('กรุณากรอก LINE ID และข้อมูลติดต่อฉุกเฉินให้ครบถ้วน', true); return; }
  if(!document.getElementById('f-pdpa-consent').checked){ toast('กรุณากดยินยอม PDPA ก่อนบันทึกข้อมูล', true); return; }

  const existing = await storeGet('member:' + phone);
  if(existing && existing.password !== password){
    toast('เบอร์โทรศัพท์นี้มีสมาชิกอยู่แล้ว กรุณากรอกรหัสผ่านเดิมให้ถูกต้องเพื่อแก้ไขข้อมูล', true);
    return;
  }

  const member = {
    university: document.getElementById('f-university').value,
    firstname: document.getElementById('f-firstname').value.trim(),
    lastname: document.getElementById('f-lastname').value.trim(),
    phone: phone,
    password: password,
    email: document.getElementById('f-email').value.trim(),
    line: document.getElementById('f-line').value.trim(),
    instagram: document.getElementById('f-instagram').value.trim(),
    emergencyPhone: document.getElementById('f-emergency-phone').value.trim(),
    emergencyRelation: document.getElementById('f-emergency-relation').value.trim(),
    medicalCondition: document.getElementById('f-medical-condition').value.trim(),
    regularMedication: document.getElementById('f-regular-medication').value.trim(),
    drugAllergy: document.getElementById('f-drug-allergy').value.trim(),
    foodRestriction: document.getElementById('f-food-restriction').value.trim(),
    pdpaConsent: document.getElementById('f-pdpa-consent').checked,
    pdpaConsentAt: document.getElementById('f-pdpa-consent').checked ? new Date().toISOString() : null,
    year: document.getElementById('f-year').value,
    dept: document.getElementById('f-dept').value,
    position: document.getElementById('f-position').value,
    bio: document.getElementById('f-bio').value.trim(),
    photo: currentPhotoData || null,
    updatedAt: new Date().toISOString()
  };

  const result = await storeSet('member:' + phone, member);
  if(!result){ toast('บันทึกไม่สำเร็จ ลองใหม่อีกครั้ง', true); return; }

  currentMemberId = phone;
  document.getElementById('gate-id').value = phone;
  document.getElementById('gate-pass').value = password;
  loadMemberIntoForm(member);
  toast('บันทึกข้อมูลเรียบร้อย — แก้ไขได้ทุกเมื่อ');
  refreshStats();
}

function closeProfile(){
  currentMemberId = null;
  currentPhotoData = null;
  document.getElementById('profile-form-wrap').style.display = 'none';
  document.getElementById('my-applications-wrap').style.display = 'none';
  document.getElementById('gate-id').value = '';
  document.getElementById('gate-pass').value = '';
  updateAuthUI(null);
}

function handlePhotoUpload(event){
  const file = event.target.files && event.target.files[0];
  if(!file) return;
  if(!file.type.startsWith('image/')){
    toast('กรุณาเลือกไฟล์รูปภาพเท่านั้น', true);
    return;
  }
  const reader = new FileReader();
  reader.onload = function(e){
    const img = new Image();
    img.onload = function(){
      // resize/crop to a square thumbnail so stored data stays small
      const size = 240;
      const canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
      canvas.width = size; canvas.height = size;
      const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
      const scale = Math.max(size / img.width, size / img.height);
      const w = img.width * scale, h = img.height * scale;
      ctx.drawImage(img, (size - w) / 2, (size - h) / 2, w, h);
      const dataUrl = canvas.toDataURL('image/jpeg', 0.82);
      currentPhotoData = dataUrl;
      document.getElementById('photo-preview').innerHTML = '<img src="'+dataUrl+'" alt="">';
      document.getElementById('id-avatar').innerHTML = '<img src="'+dataUrl+'" alt="">';
      document.getElementById('btn-remove-photo').style.display = 'inline-flex';
      toast('อัปโหลดรูปแล้ว — อย่าลืมกดบันทึกข้อมูล');
    };
    img.onerror = function(){ toast('ไม่สามารถอ่านไฟล์รูปภาพนี้ได้', true); };
    img.src = e.target.result;
  };
  reader.onerror = function(){ toast('อ่านไฟล์ไม่สำเร็จ ลองใหม่อีกครั้ง', true); };
  reader.readAsDataURL(file);
}

function removePhoto(){
  currentPhotoData = null;
  document.getElementById('f-photo').value = '';
  const initial = (document.getElementById('f-firstname').value || '?').charAt(0) || '?';
  document.getElementById('photo-preview').textContent = initial;
  document.getElementById('id-avatar').textContent = initial;
  document.getElementById('btn-remove-photo').style.display = 'none';
  toast('ลบรูปแล้ว — อย่าลืมกดบันทึกข้อมูล');
}

async function deleteAccount(){
  if(!currentMemberId){
    toast('ไม่พบบัญชีที่จะลบ', true);
    return;
  }
  const phone = currentMemberId;
  const sure = confirm('ต้องการลบบัญชีของคุณและใบสมัครทั้งหมดที่เกี่ยวข้องใช่หรือไม่?\nการลบนี้ไม่สามารถกู้คืนได้');
  if(!sure) return;

  const appKeys = await storeList('application:' + phone + ':');
  for(const key of appKeys){
    await storeDelete(key);
  }
  await storeDelete('member:' + phone);

  currentMemberId = null;
  document.getElementById('profile-form').reset();
  document.getElementById('profile-form-wrap').style.display = 'none';
  document.getElementById('my-applications-wrap').style.display = 'none';
  document.getElementById('gate-id').value = '';
  document.getElementById('gate-pass').value = '';
  document.getElementById('lookup-id').value = '';
  document.getElementById('lookup-pass').value = '';
  updateAuthUI(null);
  toast('ลบบัญชีเรียบร้อยแล้ว');
  refreshStats();
  goTo('home');
}

/* ---------------- applications ---------------- */
async function renderMyApplications(phone){
  const wrap = document.getElementById('my-applications-wrap');
  const box = document.getElementById('my-applications');
  const keys = await storeList('application:' + phone + ':');
  if(!keys || keys.length === 0){
    wrap.style.display = 'block';
    box.innerHTML = '<div class="empty">ยังไม่มีใบสมัคร — ลองดูโครงการที่เปิดรับสมัครได้ในเมนู “โครงการ”</div>';
    return;
  }
  wrap.style.display = 'block';
  const apps = await Promise.all(keys.map(k => storeGet(k)));
  box.innerHTML = apps.filter(Boolean).map(a => {
    const st = a.status || 'pending';
    const stLabel = st === 'approved' ? 'อนุมัติแล้ว' : (st === 'rejected' ? 'ปฏิเสธ' : 'รอพิจารณา');
    const stClass = st === 'approved' ? 'active' : (st === 'rejected' ? 'rejected' : 'pending');
    return `
    <div class="proj-card">
      <div class="proj-head">
        <div>
          <div class="proj-title">${escapeHtml(a.projectTitle)}</div>
          <div class="proj-tag">${escapeHtml(a.dept || 'ไม่ระบุฝ่าย')}</div>
        </div>
        <span class="badge ${stClass}">${stLabel}</span>
      </div>
      <div class="proj-desc">สมัครเมื่อ ${new Date(a.appliedAt).toLocaleString('th-TH')}</div>
    </div>
  `;
  }).join('');
}

/* ---------------- projects ---------------- */
async function renderProjects(){
  await ensureSeed();
  const keys = await storeList('project:');
  const list = document.getElementById('project-list');
  if(!keys || keys.length === 0){
    list.innerHTML = '<div class="empty">ยังไม่มีโครงการเปิดรับสมัครในขณะนี้</div>';
    return;
  }
  const projects = (await Promise.all(keys.map(k => storeGet(k)))).filter(Boolean);
  list.innerHTML = projects.map(p => `
    <div class="proj-card">
      <div class="proj-head">
        <div>
          <div class="proj-title">${escapeHtml(p.title)}</div>
          <div class="proj-tag">${escapeHtml(p.tag)}</div>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="proj-desc">${escapeHtml(p.desc)}</div>
      <div style="font-size:0.82rem; color:var(--ink-soft); margin-bottom:6px;">ฝ่าย/สังกัด:</div>
      <div class="dept-pills" data-pid="${p.id}">
        ${p.depts.map(d => `<span class="pill" onclick="selectPill(this)">${escapeHtml(d)}</span>`).join('')}
      </div>
      <div class="row-actions" style="margin-top:14px;">
        <button class="btn btn-primary" onclick="applyToProject('${p.id}', '${escapeAttr(p.title)}')">สมัครเป็น Staff (ดึงข้อมูลจากโปรไฟล์อัตโนมัติ)</button>
      </div>
    </div>
  `).join('');
  initScrollReveal(list);
  refreshStats();
}
function selectPill(el){
  el.parentElement.querySelectorAll('.pill').forEach(p=>p.classList.remove('sel'));
  el.classList.add('sel');
}

async function applyToProject(projectId, projectTitle){
  if(!currentMemberId){
    toast('กรุณาโหลดหรือลงทะเบียนโปรไฟล์ก่อนสมัคร', true);
    goTo('profile');
    return;
  }
  const member = await storeGet('member:' + currentMemberId);
  if(!member){
    toast('ไม่พบโปรไฟล์ กรุณาบันทึกข้อมูลก่อน', true);
    return;
  }
  const pillWrap = document.querySelector('.dept-pills[data-pid="'+projectId+'"]');
  const selPill = pillWrap ? pillWrap.querySelector('.pill.sel') : null;
  const dept = selPill ? selPill.textContent : (member.dept || 'ไม่ระบุฝ่าย');

  const app = {
    projectId, projectTitle, dept,
    firstname: member.firstname,
    lastname: member.lastname,
    phone: member.phone,
    email: member.email,
    university: member.university,
    status: 'pending',
    appliedAt: new Date().toISOString()
  };
  await storeSet('application:' + member.phone + ':' + projectId, app);
  toast('สมัครสำเร็จ! ระบบดึงข้อมูล ' + member.firstname + ' ' + member.lastname + ' มาให้แล้ว');
  refreshStats();
}

/* ---------------- directory ---------------- */
async function renderDirectory(){
  const keys = await storeList('member:');
  const body = document.getElementById('directory-body');
  const empty = document.getElementById('directory-empty');
  if(!keys || keys.length === 0){
    body.innerHTML = '';
    empty.style.display = 'block';
    return;
  }
  empty.style.display = 'none';
  const members = (await Promise.all(keys.map(k => storeGet(k)))).filter(Boolean);
  body.innerHTML = members.map(m => {
    const status = m.year === 'บัณฑิตแล้ว (Alumnus)' ? 'alumnus' : 'active';
    const avatarHtml = m.photo
      ? `<img src="${m.photo}" alt="" style="width:36px;height:36px;border-radius:50%;object-fit:cover;display:block;">`
      : `<div style="width:36px;height:36px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--navy);color:#fff;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-weight:600;font-size:0.9rem;font-family:'Kanit',sans-serif;">${escapeHtml((m.firstname||'?').charAt(0))}</div>`;
    return `
    <tr>
      <td>${avatarHtml}</td>
      <td>${escapeHtml((m.firstname||'') + ' ' + (m.lastname||''))}</td>
      <td>${escapeHtml(m.university||'-')}</td>
      <td>${escapeHtml(m.year||'-')}</td>
      <td>${escapeHtml(m.phone||'-')}</td>
      <td><span class="badge ${status}">${status==='alumnus' ? 'ศิษย์เก่า' : 'Active'}</span></td>
    </tr>`;
  }).join('');
  refreshStats();
}

/* ---------------- stats ---------------- */
function countUp(el, target, suffix){
  suffix = suffix || '';
  const start = 0;
  const duration = 900;
  const startTime = performance.now();
  function tick(now){
    const p = Math.min((now - startTime) / duration, 1);
    const eased = 1 - Math.pow(1 - p, 3); // ease-out cubic
    el.textContent = Math.round(start + (target - start) * eased) + suffix;
    if(p < 1) requestAnimationFrame(tick);
  }
  requestAnimationFrame(tick);
}
async function refreshStats(){
  const memberKeys = await storeList('member:');
  const el = document.getElementById('stat-members');
  if(el) countUp(el, memberKeys.length, '+');
}

/* ---------------- utils ---------------- */
function escapeHtml(s){
  return String(s ?? '').replace(/[&<>"']/g, c => ({'&':'&amp;','<':'&lt;','>':'&gt;','"':'&quot;',"'":'&#39;'}[c]));
}
function escapeAttr(s){ return escapeHtml(s).replace(/'/g, "&#39;"); }

/* ---------------- admin panel ---------------- */
const ADMIN_PASSWORD = 'rtut-admin-2026';
let adminLoggedIn = false;

function adminLogin(){
  const val = document.getElementById('admin-pass').value;
  if(val !== ADMIN_PASSWORD){
    toast('รหัสผ่าน Admin ไม่ถูกต้อง', true);
    return;
  }
  adminLoggedIn = true;
  document.getElementById('admin-gate').style.display = 'none';
  document.getElementById('admin-dashboard').style.display = 'block';
  document.getElementById('admin-pass').value = '';
  toast('เข้าสู่ระบบ Admin สำเร็จ', 'success');
  renderAdminView();
}

function adminLogout(){
  adminLoggedIn = false;
  document.getElementById('admin-gate').style.display = 'block';
  document.getElementById('admin-dashboard').style.display = 'none';
  toast('ออกจากระบบ Admin สำเร็จ', 'success-warn');
}

async function renderAdminView(){
  if(!adminLoggedIn){
    document.getElementById('admin-gate').style.display = 'block';
    document.getElementById('admin-dashboard').style.display = 'none';
    return;
  }
  document.getElementById('admin-gate').style.display = 'none';
  document.getElementById('admin-dashboard').style.display = 'block';

  const memberKeys = await storeList('member:');
  const members = (await Promise.all(memberKeys.map(k => storeGet(k)))).filter(Boolean);

  const appKeys = await storeList('application:');
  const apps = (await Promise.all(appKeys.map(async k => {
    const v = await storeGet(k);
    return v ? Object.assign({_key:k}, v) : null;
  }))).filter(Boolean);

  const projectKeys = await storeList('project:');

  countUp(document.getElementById('admin-stat-members'), members.length);
  countUp(document.getElementById('admin-stat-applications'), apps.length);
  countUp(document.getElementById('admin-stat-pending'), apps.filter(a => (a.status||'pending') === 'pending').length);
  countUp(document.getElementById('admin-stat-projects'), projectKeys.length);
  await renderElectionAdmin();

  const mBody = document.getElementById('admin-members-body');
  const mEmpty = document.getElementById('admin-members-empty');
  if(members.length === 0){
    mBody.innerHTML = '';
    mEmpty.style.display = 'block';
  }else{
    mEmpty.style.display = 'none';
    mBody.innerHTML = members.map(m => {
      const status = m.year === 'บัณฑิตแล้ว (Alumnus)' ? 'alumnus' : 'active';
      const avatarHtml = m.photo
        ? `<img src="${m.photo}" alt="" style="width:32px;height:32px;border-radius:50%;object-fit:cover;display:block;">`
        : `<div style="width:32px;height:32px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--navy);color:#fff;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-weight:600;font-size:0.85rem;font-family:'Kanit',sans-serif;">${escapeHtml((m.firstname||'?').charAt(0))}</div>`;
      return `
      <tr>
        <td>${avatarHtml}</td>
        <td>${escapeHtml((m.firstname||'') + ' ' + (m.lastname||''))}</td>
        <td>${escapeHtml(m.university||'-')}</td>
        <td>${escapeHtml(m.year||'-')}</td>
        <td>${escapeHtml(m.phone||'-')}</td>
        <td>${escapeHtml(m.email||'-')}</td>
        <td><span class="badge ${status}">${status==='alumnus' ? 'ศิษย์เก่า' : 'Active'}</span></td>
        <td><button class="btn btn-danger" style="padding:6px 12px; font-size:0.8rem;" onclick="adminDeleteMember('${escapeAttr(m.phone)}')">ลบ</button></td>
      </tr>`;
    }).join('');
  }

  const aBody = document.getElementById('admin-applications-body');
  const aEmpty = document.getElementById('admin-applications-empty');
  if(apps.length === 0){
    aBody.innerHTML = '';
    aEmpty.style.display = 'block';
  }else{
    aEmpty.style.display = 'none';
    aBody.innerHTML = apps.map(a => {
      const st = a.status || 'pending';
      const stLabel = st === 'approved' ? 'อนุมัติแล้ว' : (st === 'rejected' ? 'ปฏิเสธ' : 'รอพิจารณา');
      const stClass = st === 'approved' ? 'active' : (st === 'rejected' ? 'rejected' : 'pending');
      return `
      <tr>
        <td>${escapeHtml((a.firstname||'') + ' ' + (a.lastname||''))}<br><span style="color:var(--ink-soft); font-size:0.78rem;">${escapeHtml(a.phone||'')}</span></td>
        <td>${escapeHtml(a.projectTitle||'-')}</td>
        <td>${escapeHtml(a.dept||'-')}</td>
        <td>${new Date(a.appliedAt).toLocaleDateString('th-TH')}</td>
        <td><span class="badge ${stClass}">${stLabel}</span></td>
        <td style="white-space:nowrap;">
          <button class="btn btn-ghost" style="padding:6px 10px; font-size:0.78rem;" onclick="adminSetApplicationStatus('${escapeAttr(a._key)}','approved')">อนุมัติ</button>
          <button class="btn btn-ghost" style="padding:6px 10px; font-size:0.78rem;" onclick="adminSetApplicationStatus('${escapeAttr(a._key)}','rejected')">ปฏิเสธ</button>
          <button class="btn btn-danger" style="padding:6px 10px; font-size:0.78rem;" onclick="adminDeleteApplication('${escapeAttr(a._key)}')">ลบ</button>
        </td>
      </tr>`;
    }).join('');
  }
}

async function adminDeleteMember(phone){
  if(!adminLoggedIn) return;
  const sure = confirm('ต้องการลบสมาชิกคนนี้และใบสมัครทั้งหมดของเขาใช่หรือไม่?');
  if(!sure) return;
  const appKeys = await storeList('application:' + phone + ':');
  for(const key of appKeys){
    await storeDelete(key);
  }
  await storeDelete('member:' + phone);
  toast('ลบสมาชิกเรียบร้อยแล้ว');
  renderAdminView();
  refreshStats();
}

async function adminSetApplicationStatus(key, status){
  if(!adminLoggedIn) return;
  const app = await storeGet(key);
  if(!app){ toast('ไม่พบใบสมัคร', true); return; }
  app.status = status;
  await storeSet(key, app);
  toast(status === 'approved' ? 'อนุมัติใบสมัครแล้ว' : 'ปฏิเสธใบสมัครแล้ว');
  renderAdminView();
}

async function adminDeleteApplication(key){
  if(!adminLoggedIn) return;
  const sure = confirm('ต้องการลบใบสมัครนี้ใช่หรือไม่?');
  if(!sure) return;
  await storeDelete(key);
  toast('ลบใบสมัครแล้ว');
  renderAdminView();
}

/* ---------------- university banner: keep it seamless on any screen width ---------------- */
function setupUniBanner(){
  const track = document.getElementById('uni-banner-track');
  if(!track) return;
  const baseImgs = Array.from(track.children);
  if(baseImgs.length === 0) return;

  function fillAndDuplicate(){
    // 1) clone the base set until it's at least as wide as the viewport,
    //    so on ultra-wide screens there's never a gap of bare background.
    let guard = 0;
    while(track.scrollWidth < window.innerWidth && guard < 20){
      baseImgs.forEach(img => track.appendChild(img.cloneNode(true)));
      guard++;
    }
    // 2) mirror the whole current set exactly once more — this guarantees
    //    translateX(-50%) always lands on a pixel-identical copy, so the
    //    loop restart is invisible regardless of viewport size.
    const setWidth = track.scrollWidth;
    Array.from(track.children).forEach(img => {
      if(track.scrollWidth < setWidth * 2) track.appendChild(img.cloneNode(true));
    });
  }

  // images need to load before scrollWidth is measured correctly
  const firstImg = baseImgs[0];
  if(firstImg.complete){
    fillAndDuplicate();
  }else{
    firstImg.addEventListener('load', fillAndDuplicate, { once:true });
    firstImg.addEventListener('error', fillAndDuplicate, { once:true });
  }
}

/* subtle parallax on the hero banner while scrolling — the background drifts
   slower than the page for a bit of depth, and it's a plain translateY on
   the wrapper so it never fights with the marquee animation on the track */
function setupHeroParallax(){
  const banner = document.querySelector('.hero-bg-banner');
  const hero = document.querySelector('.scanfield.hero');
  if(!banner || !hero) return;
  if(window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches) return;
  let ticking = false;
  window.addEventListener('scroll', () => {
    if(ticking) return;
    ticking = true;
    requestAnimationFrame(() => {
      const rect = hero.getBoundingClientRect();
      const progress = Math.min(Math.max(-rect.top, 0), rect.height);
      banner.style.transform = 'translateY(' + (progress * 0.12) + 'px)';
      ticking = false;
    });
  }, { passive:true });
}

/* ---------------- intro splash ---------------- */
let splashDismissed = false;
let splashParticlesRAF = null;
function dismissSplash(){
  if(splashDismissed) return;
  splashDismissed = true;
  if(splashParticlesRAF) cancelAnimationFrame(splashParticlesRAF);
  const splash = document.getElementById('site-splash');
  document.body.classList.add('choreo-play');
  if(!splash) return;
  splash.classList.add('splash-hide');
  document.body.style.overflow = '';
  setTimeout(()=>{ if(splash.parentNode) splash.parentNode.removeChild(splash); }, 1450);
}
function initSplashParticles(){
  const canvas = document.getElementById('splash-particles');
  const splash = document.getElementById('site-splash');
  if(!canvas || !splash) return;
  if(window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches) return;
  const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
  let w, h, particles;

  function resize(){
    w = canvas.width = splash.offsetWidth;
    h = canvas.height = splash.offsetHeight;
  }
  function makeParticle(){
    return {
      x: Math.random() * w,
      y: h + Math.random() * 40,
      r: 1 + Math.random() * 2.4,
      speed: 0.35 + Math.random() * 0.9,
      drift: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.6,
      sway: Math.random() * Math.PI * 2,
      swaySpeed: 0.008 + Math.random() * 0.015,
      hue: Math.random() < 0.65 ? '255,204,0' : '51,153,255', // gold + sky, matches brand palette
      alpha: 0.25 + Math.random() * 0.55
    };
  }
  resize();
  particles = Array.from({ length: Math.min(70, Math.round(w / 16)) }, makeParticle);
  window.addEventListener('resize', resize);

  function tick(){
    ctx.clearRect(0, 0, w, h);
    particles.forEach(p => {
      p.y -= p.speed;
      p.sway += p.swaySpeed;
      p.x += p.drift + Math.sin(p.sway) * 0.4;
      if(p.y < -10){ Object.assign(p, makeParticle(), { y: h + 10 }); }
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, p.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(' + p.hue + ',' + p.alpha + ')';
      ctx.shadowColor = 'rgba(' + p.hue + ',0.8)';
      ctx.shadowBlur = 6;
      ctx.fill();
    });
    if(!splashDismissed) splashParticlesRAF = requestAnimationFrame(tick);
  }
  tick();
}
(function initSplash(){
  const splash = document.getElementById('site-splash');
  if(!splash) return;
  document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';
  initSplashParticles();
})();


/* ---------------- mouse 3D depth — follows cursor without rotating ---------------- */
function setupMouse3D(){
  if(window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches) return;

  const targets = document.querySelectorAll(
    '.panel, .stat-card, .proj-card, .id-card, .photo-preview, .pill-badge, .splash-icon-circle'
  );

  targets.forEach(el => {
    el.classList.add('mouse-3d');

    let raf = null;
    let lastX = 50, lastY = 50, lastDX = 0, lastDY = 0;

    function update(x, y){
      const rect = el.getBoundingClientRect();
      const px = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, (x - rect.left) / rect.width));
      const py = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, (y - rect.top) / rect.height));

      lastX = px * 100;
      lastY = py * 100;

      /* Tiny depth movement only — deliberately NO rotateX/rotateY tilt. */
      lastDX = (px - .5) * 5;
      lastDY = (py - .5) * 5;

      if(!raf){
        raf = requestAnimationFrame(() => {
          el.style.setProperty('--mx', lastX + '%');
          el.style.setProperty('--my', lastY + '%');
          el.style.setProperty('--dx', lastDX.toFixed(2) + 'px');
          el.style.setProperty('--dy', lastDY.toFixed(2) + 'px');
          raf = null;
        });
      }
    }

    el.addEventListener('pointermove', e => update(e.clientX, e.clientY));
    el.addEventListener('pointerleave', () => {
      el.style.setProperty('--mx', '50%');
      el.style.setProperty('--my', '50%');
      el.style.setProperty('--dx', '0px');
      el.style.setProperty('--dy', '0px');
    });
  });
}

/* ---------------- init ---------------- */
(async function init(){
  updateAuthUI(null);
  await ensureSeed();
  if(!(await storeGet(ELECTION_KEY))) await storeSet(ELECTION_KEY,{open:true,title:'เลือกตั้งประธานสมาพันธ์ RTUT'});
  renderElectionUniversities();
  await refreshStats();
  initScrollReveal(document);
  setupUniBanner();
  setupHeroParallax();
  setupMouse3D();
  setupNavIndicator();
})();
</script>
